title: 亚马逊 CEO 怎样解释岗位缩减的决定（2022）
topic: 亚马逊 CEO 怎样解释岗位缩减的决定（2022）

source.title: A note from CEO Andy Jassy about role eliminations
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 基于 Amazon CEO 2022 年员工邮件；该邮件说明了当时已宣布的岗位调整，也明确表示其余调整数量尚未确定。
paragraphs: The message below was shared with Amazon employees today.

Two weeks ago, Beth shared that S-team and I decided to pause new incremental hires in our corporate workforce. Today, I want to share some information about role eliminations. We are in the middle of our annual operating planning review where we look at each of our businesses and make decisions about what we believe we should change. Leaders across the company are working with their teams and looking at their workforce levels, investments they want to make in the future, and prioritizing what matters most to customers and the long-term health of our businesses. This year’s review is more difficult due to the fact that the economy remains in a challenging spot and we’ve hired rapidly the last several years.

Yesterday, we communicated the difficult decision to eliminate a number of positions across our Devices and Books businesses, and also announced a voluntary reduction offer for some employees in our People, Experience, and Technology (PXT) organization. Our annual planning process extends into the new year, which means there will be more role reductions as leaders continue to make adjustments. Those decisions will be shared with impacted employees and organizations early in 2023. We haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted (we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations), but each leader will communicate to their respective teams when we have the details nailed down. And, as has been the case this week, we will prioritize communicating directly with impacted employees before making broad public or internal announcements.
translations: 以下信息今日已与亚马逊员工分享。
两周前，Beth分享称，S团队和我决定暂停企业员工的新增招聘。今天，我想分享一些关于职位裁减的信息。我们正处于年度运营规划审查的中间阶段，在此过程中，我们会审视各个业务部门，并做出我们认为应该做出的改变决策。公司各层领导者正在与团队合作，评估其人员编制水平、未来想要进行的投资，并优先考虑对客户和业务长期健康最重要的事项。由于经济形势依然严峻，且过去几年我们招聘速度过快，今年的审查更加困难。

昨日，我们做出了艰难的决定，将在设备和图书业务部门裁减多个职位，同时宣布面向人力、体验和技术（PXT）组织部分员工提供自愿离职补偿方案。我们的年度规划流程将持续到新的一年，这意味着随着领导者继续进行调整，还将有更多的职位裁减。这些决策将在2023年初与受影响的员工和组织进行沟通。我们尚未最终确定还会有多少其他职位受到影响（我们知道商店和PXT组织将会有裁员），但每位领导者在细节敲定后，都会向各自团队进行沟通。此外，正如本周的情况一样，我们将在进行广泛的公开或内部公告之前，优先与受影响的员工进行直接沟通。
fullTextParagraphs: The message below was shared with Amazon employees today.

Two weeks ago, Beth shared that S-team and I decided to pause new incremental hires in our corporate workforce. Today, I want to share some information about role eliminations. We are in the middle of our annual operating planning review where we look at each of our businesses and make decisions about what we believe we should change. Leaders across the company are working with their teams and looking at their workforce levels, investments they want to make in the future, and prioritizing what matters most to customers and the long-term health of our businesses. This year’s review is more difficult due to the fact that the economy remains in a challenging spot and we’ve hired rapidly the last several years.

Yesterday, we communicated the difficult decision to eliminate a number of positions across our Devices and Books businesses, and also announced a voluntary reduction offer for some employees in our People, Experience, and Technology (PXT) organization. Our annual planning process extends into the new year, which means there will be more role reductions as leaders continue to make adjustments. Those decisions will be shared with impacted employees and organizations early in 2023. We haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted (we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations), but each leader will communicate to their respective teams when we have the details nailed down. And, as has been the case this week, we will prioritize communicating directly with impacted employees before making broad public or internal announcements.

I’ve been in this role now for about a year and a half, and without a doubt, this is the most difficult decision we’ve made during that time (and, we’ve had to make some very tough calls over the past couple of years, particularly during the heart of the pandemic). It’s not lost on me or any of the leaders who make these decisions that these aren’t just roles we’re eliminating, but rather, people with emotions, ambitions, and responsibilities whose lives will be impacted. We are working to support those who are affected and trying to help them find new roles on teams that have a need; and in cases where that’s not possible, we are offering packages that include a separation payment, transitional health insurance benefits, and external job placement support.

Amazon has weathered uncertainty and difficult economies in the past, and we will continue to do so. We have big opportunities ahead, both in our more established businesses like Stores, Advertising, and AWS, but also in our newer initiatives that we’ve been working on for a number of years and have conviction in pursuing (e.g. Prime Video, Alexa, Kuiper, Zoox, and Healthcare). The key will be to do what Amazon does best – obsess over customers and invent relentlessly on their behalf – and if we do that, we should all be very optimistic about Amazon’s future. I know I am.
I want to thank each of you for your continuing contributions during this challenging time and as we gear up to deliver for customers during the busy shopping season.

notes.phrase: The message below was shared with Amazon employees today
notes.meaning: 以下信息今日已与亚马逊员工分享
notes.explain: 使用被动语态表示信息被传达，常用于公司内部公告
notes.example: The updated company policy was shared with all department heads yesterday.

notes.explain: incremental表示逐步增加的，这里指暂停逐步增加新员工
notes.example: Due to budget constraints, we will pause new incremental hires until next quarter.

notes.explain: 比layoffs更委婉的表达，指取消某些职位而非直接解雇
notes.example: The company announced role eliminations in several departments as part of restructuring.

notes.explain: 公司提供激励措施鼓励员工自愿离职，避免强制裁员
notes.example: The tech company implemented a voluntary reduction offer to reduce workforce without layoffs.

scenario.title: Sharing what is known—and what is not yet known
english: A teammate asks how Amazon’s 2022 message described role eliminations and what would happen next.

The message referred to positions across Devices and Books and a voluntary reduction offer for some PXT employees. It said the annual planning process would continue into 2023 and that the number of additional reductions had not yet been finalized.
You explain the confirmed information and clearly separate it from decisions that were still pending.
chinese: 一位同事问，Amazon 2022 年的邮件如何说明岗位调整，以及后续会怎样。
邮件提到 Devices 和 Books 业务中的岗位调整，以及向部分 PXT 员工提供自愿离职方案。邮件说年度规划会延续到 2023 年，更多岗位调整的数量当时还没有确定。
你说明已经确认的信息，并把尚未确定的事项单独说清楚。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事问 Amazon 2022 年的邮件是否已经确定所有岗位调整人数。请用两句英文概括当时已宣布的调整，并说明额外调整人数尚未确定。
firstAttempt.sample: The message announced role eliminations in the Devices and Books businesses and a voluntary reduction offer for some PXT employees. It said the number of additional role reductions had not yet been finalized.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把已宣布事项与仍未确定的数字分开表达，不补猜测。

words.example: The company is making incremental improvements to its product line.
words.translation: 公司正在对其产品线进行渐进式改进。
words.note: 常用于描述小幅度、逐步的变化，而非剧烈变革

words.example: The manufacturing plant has a workforce of over 500 employees.
words.translation: 这家制造厂有500多名员工。
words.note: 指特定组织或行业的全体员工

words.meaning: 确定优先顺序，优先处理
words.example: We need to prioritize our tasks based on their impact on business goals.
words.translation: 我们需要根据任务对业务目标的影响来确定优先顺序。
words.note: -ing形式常用于描述正在进行的优先级排序过程

words.example: The current economic climate presents many challenging opportunities for growth.
words.translation: 当前的经济形势为增长提供了许多具有挑战性的机会。
words.note: 比difficult更正式，常用于商业环境描述

words.example: The company announced budget reductions for the upcoming fiscal year.
words.translation: 公司宣布了下一财年的预算削减。
words.note: reduction的复数形式，常与具体减少内容搭配使用

words.example: We need to nail down the details of the contract before signing.
words.translation: 我们需要在签约前敲定合同的细节。
words.note: 口语化表达，表示最终确定某事，常用于商业谈判

structure.original: Two weeks ago, Beth shared that S-team and I decided to pause new incremental hires in our corporate workforce.
analysis: 时间状语'Two weeks ago'位于句首，表示动作发生的时间
主句结构为'Beth shared that...'，其中that引导宾语从句，说明Beth分享的内容
宾语从句中，'S-team and I'是主语，由连词'and'连接两个并列主语，表示决策者
谓语动词'decided to pause'表示决定暂停，后接不定式短语作宾语
宾语部分包含名词短语'new incremental hires'，其中'new'和'incremental'都是形容词修饰'hires'
介词短语'in our corporate workforce'作地点状语，说明暂停招聘的范围
structure.transfer: Last week, the team paused non-essential purchases while the budget was reviewed.

rewrite.bad: Amazon had finalized every role reduction and announced one fixed number for all teams.
rewrite.good: The message announced role eliminations in the Devices and Books businesses and a voluntary reduction offer for some PXT employees. It said the number of additional role reductions had not yet been finalized.
rewrite.translation: 邮件宣布 Devices 和 Books 业务会裁减岗位，并向部分 PXT 员工提供自愿离职方案；额外裁员人数当时尚未确定。
rewrite.pattern: The message confirmed [the announced changes] but said [what remained undecided].

cloze.why: 先说清邮件已经确认的组织调整。

cloze.prompt: The number of additional reductions has not been ___.
cloze.why: has not been finalized 明确人数尚未确定。

cloze.prompt: We should wait for the next ___ before treating the wider impact as decided.
cloze.why: 等待后续信息，避免把未定内容说成已决定。

choice.prompt: 同事问 Amazon 2022 年的邮件是否已经确定所有岗位调整人数。请用两句英文概括当时已宣布的调整，并说明额外调整人数尚未确定。
options: The message describes a specific organizational change and separates confirmed details from what was still undecided.

The message announced role eliminations in the Devices and Books businesses and a voluntary reduction offer for some PXT employees. It said the number of additional role reductions had not yet been finalized.
The message announced that all teams would receive the same fixed severance package and new role.
choice.why: 把已宣布事项与仍未确定的数字分开表达，不补猜测。

output.prompt: 一封员工邮件只说明部分组织调整已经确认，其他岗位变化仍在评估。同事却转述成“全部人数已经定了”。请用英文澄清已知和未定的信息。
output.sample: The message confirms some role changes, but it says the number of additional reductions has not been finalized. We should wait for the next update before treating the wider impact as decided.
check: 是否区分已经宣布的决定和仍在评估的事项？
